title: chalcas siamensis
intro: Chalcas siamensis, commonly known as Thai angelica or Thai licorice, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including the improvement of digestion, reduction of inflammation, and regulation of blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Chalcas siamensis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may contribute to its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Chalcas siamensis include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
